Two Iranians Charged in UK Over Alleged Terror Plot Targeting Jewish Community

Two Iranian nationals have been charged in the United Kingdom in connection with an alleged terrorism plot targeting the Jewish community. Police accused the two men of planning an attack, with one report specifying the alleged plot was timed for Yom Kippur. The men appeared in court in Manchester. Authorities have not publicly disclosed further details regarding the specific nature of the alleged plot or the evidence.
